scientific_integrity: Deterministic all-size reduction and elementary probabilistic limit arguments; finite exhaustive simulation is independent corroboration rather than an infinite proof. Novelty is qualified by incomplete global literature indexing. No third-party independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Synchronous binary strict-neighbor majority with tie retention on loopless friendship graphs; i.i.d. biased peripheral opinions conditional on the initial center. No extension to asynchronous, noisy, or alternative tie rules, and no full-state information-theoretic recovery claim.
title: Two bias thresholds and majority reversals on friendship graphs
